scenarios.name: test-prevent-damage-from-spell
scenarios.known_bug: XP[choosesource-choice-not-selectable]: Refraction Trap's ChooseSource ask is posed but its card options carry Obj and no Label (effChooseSource/sourceChoices), so the ported setChoice(playerB, "Lightning Bolt") is not offered and the fallback records the empty first option. With no chosen source the ReDamage replacement's ValidSource$ Card.ChosenCardStrict never matches: the Bolt is not prevented (p1 17, want 20) and the ReplaceDamage/DealDamage chain never runs (Silvercoat Lion graveyard 0, want 1). The old "ValidTgts$ Any not posed at cast / unlinked replacement" reason is stale -- the target is asked at cast and the replacement primitive is implemented. CR 601.2c, 615.5. verified at gorge 08fc227a61.
